candidates.name: Developing estates: estate boundary approval (practice guide 41, supplement 1)
verified_facts: Estate boundary approval compares a developer's first site survey with the extent of the registered title.
HM Land Registry compares external survey boundaries with the registered title and latest Ordnance Survey map.
The service can identify differences between physical external boundaries and registered title boundaries early.
semantic_limits: Estate-boundary approval reconciles plan/registered-extent context; it is not LiDAR terrain provenance and does not itself provide parcel elevation.

candidates.name: Developing estates: approval of draft transfers and leases (practice guide 41, supplement 3)
verified_facts: The guide was updated on 2 March 2026.
The service is intended to identify and resolve difficulties in standard plot transfers and leases before registration.
Approved deeds support a consistent registration process across a development.
semantic_limits: Draft transfer or lease approval is conveyancing/registration evidence and must not be substituted for surveyed boundary coordinates or terrain height evidence.
